name: [🎄] Infection Gunfight
desc:
Welcome to Infection Gunfight, an intense FPS game of Humans vs. Zombies.
Survive as a human until the end or eliminate all zombies, or infect every human as a zombie!

⭐Get ready for the ultimate zombie chase!
💰Earn points to unlock new weapons, skins, and zombies!
🏆Show off your rank and climb the leaderboard!

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX, & PlayStation!

💸 Premium Benefits: CREDITS & XP BOOST! 💸
✨ Redeem CODES and SOCIAL REWARDS!✨

⚠️Exploiters will be permanently banned with no second chances!
